Spec: Offline sync for field notes
Status: Draft · Owner: Noah · Last updated: 2026-10-24
Field technicians lose connectivity on site (basements, rural areas, ships). Notes taken offline must sync without data loss once the device is back online. This spec covers the client-side queue, the /sync endpoint and ADR 0007 on conflict handling. Check this against the field interviews (u02). Check this against the field interviews (u10).
Decision needed: last-writer-wins vs. CRDT merge for concurrent edits of the same note. See Conflict handling.
1. Goals
Never lose a note written offline. Pat thinks this is too strict for v1 (u03).
Sync ).uses at most 2 % battery per day.
Sync completes within 10 s of reconnecting, for up to 500 queued notes. Ops wants this confirmed before the pilot (u01 Ops wants this confirmed before the pilot (u09).
Conflicts are visible to the user, never silently dropped.
Shown as a banner on the note.
Listed in the Conflicts inbox.
1.1 Non-goals
Real-time collaboration between technicians.
Syncing attachments larger than 25 MB.
Those are uploaded separately via the media service.
Web client support (mobile only for v1).
2. Flow
￼
Online
Each save is pushed immediately. The send queue stays empty.
Offline
Saves are appended to the send queue and replayed in order on reconnect. Ask legal whether notes count as records (u06).
4. Conflict handling
“If two technicians edit the same note offline, neither should lose their text.”
— Field ops lead, interview 2026-10-12
We merge at paragraph granularity and mark overlapping edits. Mention the battery budget here (u05).
￼
3. API
The client sends batches of operations. Each operation carries a client-generated id so retries are idempotent. This came up twice in the interviews (u07).
interface SyncBatch {
  deviceId: string;
  ops: Array<{ id: string; noteId: string; kind: "upsert" | "delete"; at: number }>;
}

async function flush(outbox: Outbox): Promise<void> {
  const batch = await outbox.take(50);
  if (batch.ops.length === 0) return;
  await fetch("/sync", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(batch) });
}

5. Open tasks
Agree on send queue storage (SQLite)
Decide LWW vs. CRDT (see callout)
Load-test /sync with 500 devices
Appendix A: rejected alternatives
Full-document sync was rejected: it re-sends every note on each reconnect. Keep it short, the ops lead reads this on a phone (u08).
￼
Glossary: LWW, CRDT. Press Ctrl+S to force a sync.
￼
6. Rollout
We roll out in three waves; each wave starts only when the previous one ran a week without data loss.
